name: reconcileai
description: ReconcileAI — Intelligent Digital Record Reconciliation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/engine && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/engine && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
